title: ACTIVE originator stored string
_note: Parity vector transcribed from capture .softhouse/capture/origination/out/loan-originators-template-raw.json (GET /loan-originators/template, tenant gerege). request.name="ACTIVE" came from the capture statusOptions array entry "ACTIVE"; expect.stored="ACTIVE" is that same entry's string value. LoanOriginatorStatus is a STRING enum (no ordinal column): the oracle stores the enum name itself, declared in LoanOriginatorStatus.java:23-28 as ACTIVE("ACTIVE"). A wrong name-to-string mapping (e.g. ACTIVE stored as PENDING) silently corrupts every originator written and nothing throws.
